name: Symbol Audit
description: Reviews Rust dependency bumps for capability creep and supply-chain risk.
about: A supply-chain reviewer for Rust projects. When Cargo.lock changes, this bot explains what each dependency actually started doing: new network calls, process spawning, build scripts that download and execute payloads, typosquats, fresh publishes, and known advisories. It reads the evidence and helps you decide whether the bump is safe to merge.
features: Explains what changed in a dependency's compiled surface
Flags build scripts that download and execute payloads
Drafts sign-off ledger entries once you approve a version
examplePrompt: Cargo.lock just bumped three crates. Review the changes and tell me if any of them started doing something new.
